rca_of_issue.issue: HOME button navigation failed from gameover overlay (FIXED)
rca_of_issue.root_cause: play.tsx used router.back() for navigation (lines 336, 494). router.back() only works when there's a previous page in navigation history. When user directly accesses /play or refreshes, there's no history to go back to, causing 'GO_BACK was not handled' error.
reproduction_steps: 1. Navigate directly to /play route (or refresh page)
2. Start game and wait for game over
3. Click HOME button on gameover overlay
4. Observe: stays on /play, console shows 'GO_BACK was not handled' error
rca_of_issue.fix_applied: Replaced router.back() with router.push('/') in both locations (lines 336 and 494) for back-to-home-button and home-from-gameover-button. Verified fix works correctly - both buttons now navigate to landing page reliably.
